thread:
paul: Quick pulse from the pilot yesterday  we ran the 3-hour SI enablement workshop with 5 partners. High-level: labs flow OK, but exam bank needs clearer question mapping to playbook modules. Thoughts on next steps?
sana: Thanks for the recap. Observations: partners often asked which lab maps to 'routing & failover' vs 'dedicated tuning'. Our playbook should include a 1-line mapping table and a short "what you should learn" bullet per lab.
liam: Agreed. Also noticed many failed the "rollback" question in the exam even though they completed the rollback lab. Could be wording mismatch: exam asks "how to restore KV cache after partial rollout" but lab covers cache invalidation. We should standardize language.
yuri: I can take the exam bank and align each question to a module_id. Proposal: add metadata to each question: module_id, difficulty (1-3), and expected_artifact (log URL or command output). That way the auto-grader can validate artifacts.
paul: Love that. Can you draft a sample question with metadata? Keep it short.
yuri: Sample (YAML-like):
```yaml
question_id: q-rollback-001
prompt: "You rolled out v2 and observe 12% higher latency. Provide the 3-step rollback to v1 preserving KV cache where possible."
module_id: routing-failover
difficulty: 2
expected_artifact: logs/rollback-20240315.txt
```
sana: Nice. For artifacts, partners upload to a signed S3 URL we generate during lab completion. The auto-grader fetches and runs a small regex check. Need to document allowed artifact formats (txt, json, tar.gz).
liam: On proctoring: pilot partners were mixed on live walkthroughs. Some prefer live SE sessions; others want fast auto-issue Bronze. Suggest we keep Bronze auto (artifact+smoke tests) and offer optional live SE session that upgrades them to Silver immediately after. Also record the SE session and attach link to partner profile for audit.
paul: Good balance. Also marketing asked for measurable KPIs for the pilot. Suggest: time-to-bronze, % self-serve completions, pass-rate on first attempt, and time-to-silver. We should instrument these.
yuri: I'll add telemetry keys: si_pilot_id, time_to_bronze_ms, self_serve_bool, exam_attempts, proctor_type (auto|live). Can we add that to the lab runner?
sana: Yes. Ops: please ensure lab runner includes headers with partner_id and cohort tag. And add a small TTL for signed URLs (48h).
liam: Also bring up localization: two APAC partners asked for simplified Chinese translations for playbook steps and exam prompts. We should plan a localization pass for Q3. Anyone own that?
paul: Partnerships to coordinate with Docs & DevEx. I'll open a brief to prioritize "playbook strings" first.
yuri: One more: bad actor mitigation. We had one partner retrying exams rapidly. Propose: rate-limit exam attempts to 5 per 24h and require a 24h cooldown after 3 failed attempts before live SE intervention is needed. Add to cert policy.
sana: Good call. Also add a tiny forgiveness flow: if partner shows improvement in lab artifacts we can reset cooldown. Keep edge cases documented.
paul: Action items: 1) Yuri: align exam bank metadata + draft auto-grader rules (ETA Wed); 2) Sana: update playbook mapping table + artifact format list (ETA Tue); 3) Liam: add telemetry keys and HMAC for artifact uploads (ETA Thu); 4) Paul: open localization brief + pilot KPI dashboard (ETA Fri). enablement-bot: create tasks?
enablement-bot: Task created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-9001 "Align exam bank + auto-grader rules".
paul: Thanks all. We'll iterate and run a second pilot in 3 weeks with the updated exam bank. :rocket:
